All text was still legible after enlargement. Upright upper-case balloon lettering; captions are italic on pale yellow boxes (or on the page background for region 10). Western romance; several balloons sit on black panel backgrounds.

regions.text: THE NEXT MORNING WE STARTED FOR THE RANGE...
regions.notes: Italic, dark on a pale yellow caption box; red drop initial 'T'.

regions.text: TANA IS A WONDERFUL GIRL, CACTUS, BUT I'M STILL NOT SURE I DID THE RIGHT THING HIRIN' HER FOR THIS JOB...
regions.notes: Lettered 'WONDER-' / 'FUL' across a line break; written as the whole word.

regions.text: YOU'LL GET OVER THAT FEELIN', GIL. MISS TANA'S A THOROUGHBRED AN' A THOROUGHBRED DON'T GIT STAMPEDED.
regions.notes: Second THOROUGHBRED is lettered 'THOROUGH-' / 'BRED' across a line break; written whole.

regions.text: I COOKED LUNCH FOR THE CREW OVER MESQUITE COALS AT A WATERING SPOT...
regions.notes: Italic, dark on pale blue-grey caption box. The first letter is a decorative initial that looks like a slashed 0; read as I from context (first-person narrator).

regions.text: WE NEVER HAD A BISCUIT SHOOTER THAT DID THIS ANY EASIER, TANA. WHEN WE HIT THE RANGE TONIGHT, I'LL PUT UP THE GRUB TENT FOR YOU, AND THAT CAN BE YOUR CAMP.
regions.notes: The mark after TANA is printed blurred (comma or full stop); full stop chosen because WHEN starts a new sentence. Low-resolution source.
Italic, dark on pale yellow; red drop initial 'T'. Four dots, as drawn.

regions.text: I WONDER IF YOU KNOW HOW WONDERFUL YOU ARE, TANA.
ARE YOU REALLY BEGINNING TO FEEL THAT IT WAS ALL RIGHT TO HIRE ME, GIL?
GIL AND I SAT THERE WHILE THE FIRE DIED DOWN, LONG AFTER THE OTHERS ROLLED UP IN THEIR BLANKETS...
regions.notes: Italic, unboxed, on the page background; red drop initial 'G'.

regions.text: TONIGHT HAS BEEN WONDERFUL FOR ME, TOO. I NEVER REMEMBER THE RANGE BEING THIS BEAUTIFUL BEFORE.
regions.notes: Lettered 'RE-' / 'MEMBER' across a line break; written as the whole word.

regions.text: OH, TANA! THIS IS WHAT I WAS AFRAID OF.
I HAD NO RIGHT TO DO THAT. FORGIVE ME. I--I'M ENGAGED.
regions.notes: 'I--' ends a line and 'I'M' starts the next; joined as 'I--I'M'.

regions.text: I--I KNOW--SO--SO IT WAS AS MUCH MY FAULT AS YOURS.
regions.notes: Line 2 starts with '--SO--SO'; joined to KNOW without spaces as a reader would read the stammer.
